title: onopen --json report, schema_version 1
description: What `onopen --json` prints. Fields are only ever added within schema_version 1; consumers must ignore fields they do not know. See docs/CONTRACT.md.

schema_version.description: Shape of this document. Changes only on a breaking change.

version.description: Version of onopen that produced the report (semver).

root.description: The path that was scanned, as given on the command line.

suppressed.description: Findings an ignore file silenced. Counted and carried, never dropped.

unreadable.description: Configuration files that exist and could not be read. Any entry here makes the exit code 2.

stale_ignore_lines.description: 1-based lines of the ignore file that silenced nothing in this run.

file.description: Path relative to the scanned root, `/`-separated, exact (not escaped).

trigger.description: What makes it run. Whitespace collapsed, at most 120 characters.

command.description: What would run. Whitespace collapsed, at most 120 characters, otherwise exact.

note.description: One line on why this is an execution path. Wording may change.

file.description: Path relative to the scanned root, `/`-separated.

reason.description: Why it could not be read. At most about 400 characters. Wording may change.

files_cleared.description: Configuration files read that contained no execution path.
